findings.governingReading: Close in on someone is the required construction for approaching her.
findings.explanation: Close in Tohsaka omits the preposition on.

findings.highlight: can you think of a way to protect her!?
findings.evidenceJa: なんとか知られないまま守れる方法
findings.governingReading: 知られないまま is part of the requested protective method, distinct from merely keeping the discussion from passing students.
findings.explanation: Protecting Sakura without her finding out loses the secrecy requirement.

findings.highlight: I know it's really pushing it
findings.evidenceJa: 謝ってばっかりだけど
findings.governingReading: 謝ってばっかりだけど refers to his constant apologizing in this awkward approach.
findings.explanation: Acknowledging repeated apologies becomes acknowledging an excessive request.
